Dimension.title: Dimension
Dimension.description: A positive linear measurement in millimeters.

x.title: X
x.description: X coordinate in millimeters, relative to the part's local origin.

y.title: Y
y.description: Y coordinate in millimeters, relative to the part's local origin.

Point2D.title: Point2D
Point2D.description: A 2D position in millimeters, relative to the part's local origin.

x.title: X
x.description: X coordinate in millimeters, relative to the part's local origin.

y.title: Y
y.description: Y coordinate in millimeters, relative to the part's local origin.

z.title: Z
z.description: Z coordinate in millimeters, relative to the part's local origin.

Point3D.title: Point3D
Point3D.description: A 3D position in millimeters, relative to the part's local origin.

angle.title: Angle
angle.description: Included angle of the countersink cone, in degrees.

Countersink.title: Countersink
Countersink.description: A countersink recess for a flat-head fastener, defined by diameter and included angle.

Counterbore.title: Counterbore
Counterbore.description: A counterbore recess for a fastener head, defined by diameter and depth.

id.title: Id
id.description: Optional stable identifier for this hole, used to reference it from features or diagnostics.

x.title: X
x.description: X coordinate of the hole center in millimeters, relative to the part's local origin.

y.title: Y
y.description: Y coordinate of the hole center in millimeters, relative to the part's local origin.

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: Hole depth in millimeters, or "through" to cut completely through the part.

axis.title: Axis
axis.description: Axis the hole is drilled along; "z" is the default vertical axis for flat parts.

Hole.title: Hole
Hole.description: A cylindrical hole to subtract from the part, with an optional countersink or counterbore.

id.title: Id
id.description: Optional stable identifier for this slot, used to reference it from features or diagnostics.

x.title: X
x.description: X coordinate of the slot center in millimeters, relative to the part's local origin.

y.title: Y
y.description: Y coordinate of the slot center in millimeters, relative to the part's local origin.

length.title: Length
length.description: Slot length in millimeters, measured along its long axis.

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: Slot depth in millimeters, or "through" to cut completely through the part.

axis.title: Axis
axis.description: Axis the slot is cut along.

Slot.title: Slot
Slot.description: A rectangular slot to subtract from the part.

target.title: Target
target.description: Optional identifier of the edge or feature this fillet applies to; omit to apply it to the whole part where supported.

Fillet.title: Fillet
Fillet.description: A rounded edge finishing request, defined by radius.

distance.title: Distance
distance.description: Chamfer distance in millimeters, measured along each adjoining face.

target.title: Target
target.description: Optional identifier of the edge or feature this chamfer applies to; omit to apply it to the whole part where supported.

Chamfer.title: Chamfer
Chamfer.description: A beveled edge finishing request, defined by distance.

countX.title: CountX
countX.description: Number of repetitions along the X axis.

countY.title: CountY
countY.description: Number of repetitions along the Y axis.

spacingX.title: SpacingX
spacingX.description: Spacing between repetitions along the X axis, in millimeters.

spacingY.title: SpacingY
spacingY.description: Spacing between repetitions along the Y axis, in millimeters.

oneOf.title: RectangularPattern
oneOf.description: A rectangular grid pattern defined by repetition counts and spacing along the X and Y axes.

oneOf.title: LinearPattern
oneOf.description: A linear pattern defined by a repetition count and spacing along one axis.

count.title: Count
count.description: Number of repetitions around the circle.

radius.title: Radius
radius.description: Radius of the circle the repetitions are placed on, in millimeters.

startAngle.title: StartAngle
startAngle.description: Starting angle of the first repetition, in degrees, measured counterclockwise from the X axis.

sweepAngle.title: SweepAngle
sweepAngle.description: Total angle the pattern sweeps through, in degrees; omit for a full 360-degree pattern.

oneOf.title: RadialPattern
oneOf.description: A radial (circular) pattern defined by a repetition count around a center point.

Pattern.title: Pattern
Pattern.description: A rectangular, linear, or radial repetition pattern for a feature.

supplier.title: Supplier
supplier.description: Supplier or vendor name, for example "McMaster-Carr".

partNumber.title: PartNumber
partNumber.description: Supplier's part number or SKU for this item.

url.title: Url
url.description: Optional URL to the supplier's product page for this item.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional human-readable description of the supplier listing.

SupplierReference.title: SupplierReference
SupplierReference.description: A reference to where a hardware item can be purchased.

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable identifier for this hardware item, used in BOM output and project relationships.

standard.title: Standard
standard.description: Optional fastener standard, for example "ISO 4762" or "DIN 912".

size.title: Size
size.description: Optional size designation, for example "M3x8" or "#4-40".

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.description: Number of this hardware item required.

role.title: Role
role.description: Optional description of how this hardware is used, for example "lid screw" or "heat-set insert".

items.title: SupplierReference
items.description: A supplier reference for this hardware item.

supplierReferences.title: SupplierReferences
supplierReferences.description: Optional list of supplier references for sourcing this hardware item.

HardwareItem.title: HardwareItem
HardwareItem.description: A bill-of-materials entry for a fastener, insert, or other hardware component used by the part.
